about:
# Labeled Checkpoints
This mod adds a <cy>percentage label</c> to practice checkpoints.

## Who is this for?
Anyone who forgot what percentage they placed a checkpoint in.

**If you've never had this problem, then this mod is probably <cr>not</c> for you.**

## Note
This mod does <cr>not</c> and <cr>will never</c> work on <cy>Platformer mode</c>.
changelog:
# 1.3.0
- <cg>Updated</c> to <cy>Geode 5.9.0</c> (so I can use `geode::Label`)
- <cg>Added</c> proper tags
- <cg>Added</c> a new setting: "Only Show Percentage"

# 1.2.1
- Made the custom font setting more <cg>foolproof</c> (in other words, check if the corresponding PNG file exists)

# 1.2.0
- <cg>Added</c> the ability to use a .fnt file

# 1.1.0
- <cg>Added</c> settings to:
    - Control <cy>how many decimal places to show in the percentage label</c>
    - Change the <cy>label's opacity</c>
    - <cy>Shrink</c> or <cy>enlarge</c> the label
    - Change the <cy>label's font</c>
    - Change the <cy>label's color</c>
- <cy>Changed</c> the mod icon
- <cg>Added</c> a button in the pause menu that opens the mod's <cy>settings</c>

# 1.0.0
- Initial release
